== Course of events ==

During the chaotic tea-party at the table where time remains eternally frozen at tea-time, the Dormouse recounts a peculiar and meandering tale. The story concerns three sisters—Elsie, Lacie, and Tillie—who dwelt at the bottom of a treacle-well. According to the Dormouse's account, these sisters occupied themselves with drawing, their subject matter restricted to things whose names commenced with the letter M.

The Dormouse's narration serves as an interlude amid the Hatter's riddling and the absurd customs of the perpetually stalled tea-party, where cups must be constantly rotated to find clean vessels since dishes go unwashed. The rambling quality of the tale reflects the dream-logic of Wonderland itself, wandering from point to point with the same peculiar certainty that governs the tea-table's eternal routines.

Following this recounting, the conversation returns to the Hatter's riddles and his own troubles—most notably his quarrel with Time and the riddle of why a raven should resemble a writing-desk—as the tea-party's strange customs and stranger discourse continue unabated.
